title: Vast statement
description: A flat moon-rock band with one large mission statement (48px, medium weight, tight) in a narrow left column and small '+' crop marks in the four corners. The words start dim asteroid-dust brown and turn white one after another as the band scrolls into view, driven by the scroll position.
notes: the band is the theme's muted colour with white (highlight-foreground) text; pick a theme where those contrast
the word colour reveal uses CSS scroll-driven animations; without support the text simply shows in white
about 16 words reads best; the stagger is 2.5% of the entry per word
name: vastspace-statement
